record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.
record.final_answer:
I rebuilt the page, which is now at `site/public/prices.html`. It lists **6 products**, and the cheapest is the **Fable pencil set at 7.60**.

The full list, sorted by name:

| Product | Price |
|---|---|
| Anchor mug | 14.50 |
| Bramble journal | 8.90 |
| Dune tote bag | 24.00 |
| Fable pencil set | 7.60 |
| Gale scarf | 31.50 |
| Ivy plant pot | 13.20 |

`products.json` has 10 products, but the page only shows the active ones. Juniper soap (5.90) and Ember tea tin (7.20) are cheaper than the pencil set, but they're marked inactive, so they aren't on the page.

`build.js` reads and writes files relative to the folder it's run from, so it has to be run from inside `site/` (`cd site && node build.js`). I didn't change `build.js`.
